reviews.title: Use to love it, now too many ads
reviews.text: I got this app when it was free to use. I loved it! I loved changing the colors for each event. Easy to use and great colors. I liked how it synced to Google Calendar. I used it free for years. Then it changed. They put ads continuously! You could hardly look at the calendar without a minute long add popping up. It got so annoying. I didn’t want to pay for it so I endured ads for months. The last straw came when they want me to pay monthly in order to have a reoccurring event. Are you kidding me!! Just no. I immediately looked into other calendars and found Apple calendar that comes with my phone basically has all the same features for FREE!! No annoying ads! So I switched.

I’m assuming you’ll have to pay the 1.99 a month to get the “pro” version for the ads to go away. But not even paying gets them to go away. But if your like me and your not paying for this stupid thing then i highly recommend don’t get this app if you don’t want ads every two minutes. Every time you open the app or click anything an ad will pop up that you can’t skip until it’s over. Do you know how annoying that is? Let me tell you, ITS VERY!! And to the creator that did this update I’m very mad at you. I loved this app before you went and added this dumb stuff! I’m very disappointed.

reviews.text: This app has over taken my iPhone calendar and now I have to watch adverts to access it. I also have to pay for some functions that were free before. Would appreciate advice as to how to deactivate it and return to my iPhone ‘free’ calendar
